snippet.title: Kitten Space Agency - First Look Teaser
snippet.description:
A first look at Kitten Space Agency, a new spaceflight simulation game from RocketWerkz.

Captured from real-time in-game footage in our May 2026 pre-alpha build, version 2026.6.6.4601. No pre-rendered cinematics.

This is our first early development teaser, showing work-in-progress footage from the game that has been in development since mid-2024, with public pre-alpha builds first released in November 2025.

Kitten Space Agency is being built to make spaceflight inspiring, approachable, and free to download. Players will be able to support development through optional contributions on Ahwoo.
